Players Committee card image of [[They Will Be No Match For You (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table. Once per turn, may deploy Maul's Lightsaber from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. At start of opponent's control phase, may relocate Maul to same site as a Jedi. May place this Effect out of play to deploy Maul's Lightsaber from Lost Pile. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/theywillbenomatchforyou.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
